display.title: Episode 256: Little Zalmy and the Spooky House, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: The Shabbos Candlestick Contest's last week, a grandfather and granddaughter from Russia lead the Shema, and a new serial begins: young Schneur Zalman and the mystery of the spooky house.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi announces the last week of the Shabbos Candlestick Contest and looks back on five years of Tzivos Hashem contests, from tzitzis to Sefer Torah. After the Hakochainik march, a sponsor message offers Chanukah gifts and Uncle Yossi's story tapes on sale. In Studio 604, a five-year-old girl and her grandfather, recently arrived from Russia and grateful to keep mitzvos in freedom, lead the Shema together. Story time begins a true story about the Alter Rebbe as a six-year-old in Liozna: little Schneur Zalman, raised by parents famous for hachnasas orchim, fills two baskets with food for 'some very hungry souls' and slips away before Kreindel the cook can find out his secret. Meanwhile two boys, brave Shimmy and nervous Zelig, hide inside the town's abandoned spooky house to solve its mystery, and at nightfall they hear many footsteps approaching. Mitzvah time continues the brachah over Shabbos candles with the words 'Melech HaOlam': Hashem is King of the whole world, the King of all kings. The show closes with candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: You are never too young to do a mitzvah like tzedakah, and in every brachah we speak to Hashem, the King of the whole world.
